description: This file defines the I18NHelper class in the OrangeHRM project, providing internationalization support functions such as translating strings and setting translator language, utilizing an external I18NService component.

classes.name: I18NHelper
classes.description: Provides methods for internationalization such as translating keys, translating by source string, and setting the translator's language, leveraging an internal I18NService and configuration settings.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Provides translation for a given key; returns the key if I18N is disabled in configuration.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Provides translation based on source language string; returns the source string if I18N is disabled.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the current translator language for the I18NService.
